Maria: Hey folks, quick ping — opened PR to change KV prefetching and batching heuristic that should reduce cold token latency by ~12%. Need review/approval, hoping to merge before today's deploy window.
https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4821

AJ: Linking the PR, thanks Maria. I'll take a look in ~30m. Any perf numbers or simple repro steps?

Maria: Perf numbers in the PR description. Basic repro: run bench_prefetch.sh with --seq 1024, compare latency p99. Also note there's a small kernel tweak in attn_tiling that interacts with prefetch.

Kevin: Quick heads-up — attn_tiling tweak looked OK in isolation but introduced a routing edge-case on multi-GPU. Did you test with 2xA100 config?

Maria: Tested locally on 2xV100 sim, CI has a 2-gpu smoke job. Haven't had access to 2xA100 infra; if CI passes I'll still want canary in dedicated tomorrow.

Jess: @Kevin — can you run a quick multi-GPU smoke on your rig? If not I can spin up a repro node.

Kevin: I can run it in ~1h, will post results here.

devon: CI shows one flaky test failing in test_batch_scheduler.py — looks like timing-dependent. Maria can you add a small sleep in test to stabilize or I can propose a fix?

Maria: Thanks Devon — I pushed a follow-up with a retry loop for that test. PTAL.

ci-bot: CI / unit-tests — runtime (linux) #4821 passed in 12m 34s

AJ: Skimmed the change — code looks good. Concern: KV prefetch default windowsize lowered could increase memory use for long contexts. Can we add a config knob and doc note?

Maria: Added config flag --kv-prefetch-window and docs snippet to PR, default unchanged.

Kevin: Multi-GPU smoke passed locally. No routing hangs observed. p99 latency improved as expected.

Jess: I left a small comment about logging verbosity in the prefetcher. Not blocking.

AJ: Approving now. @Maria please squash and merge after CI green and Kevin's multi-gpu smoke is in CI or sign-off.

Maria: Will squash. Kevin — can you re-run the CI smoke job once I've merged? Or I can trigger a canary on dedicated.

Kevin: I'll trigger a dedicated canary after merge. 👍

ci-bot: Merge queued by Maria. Merge completed: runtime@main <- runtime#4821

Maria: Merged. Canary scheduled for the dedicated pool (tag: canary/kv-prefetch-4821). Monitor dashboards for error-rate and p99.

Jess: Noting rollback plan: if errors spike >0.5% in 15m window we'll roll back to previous commit. I've added an alert.

devon: Great, will keep an eye on test flakiness and clean up follow-up once canary stable.

AJ: Thanks everyone for quick reviews. :tada:
